capabilities: find synonyms for a selected word via right-click, ribbon, or command palette
replace the selected word with a chosen synonym
look up synonyms offline from local thesaurus dictionary files
complement local results with online sources (Thesaurus.com, Synonymer.se)
add custom synonyms via dialog or a JSON file
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Dictionary data credited to Synlex; bundled dictionaries available via a release zip.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up synonyms for a word while writing, especially offline or in Swedish.

relations.evidence: To add support for additional languages, download thesaurus files from the LibreOffice dictionaries repository

summary: Thesaurus plugin that finds synonyms for a selected word via local dictionary files and online lookup, and can replace the word.
